alcohol-reactions: Alcohol reaction notes: converting OH to a leaving group with TsCl or MsCl, PBr3 and SOCl2 halide routes, stereochemistry, and acid dehydration to alkenes.
amine-synthesis: Amine synthesis: why direct alkylation overreacts, Gabriel, azide and nitrile routes, reductive amination, amide and nitro reduction, Hofmann and Curtius.
amino-acids: Amino acid notes covering zwitterions, charge at each pH, isoelectric point, electrophoresis, side chain classes, L configuration, and lab syntheses.
bond-polarity: Notes on bond polarity and dipole moments: drawing bond dipoles, adding them into a molecular dipole, symmetry cancelling, boiling points and solubility.
claisen: Claisen condensation notes: the step-by-step mechanism to a beta-ketoester, why final deprotonation drives it, crossed Claisens, and Dieckmann cyclization.
conjugated-systems: Conjugated diene notes: isolated vs conjugated vs cumulated double bonds, the stabilization from heats of hydrogenation, s-cis and s-trans, and pi MOs.
h-nmr: 1H NMR notes explaining chemical shift, pi-bond anisotropy, integration, counting equivalent hydrogens, n+1 splitting, and working a full spectrum.
hydrates-cyanohydrins: Carbonyl hydrate and cyanohydrin notes: reversible addition of water, HCN and bisulfite to aldehydes and ketones, and what sets each equilibrium.
kinetic-thermodynamic: Kinetic vs thermodynamic control explained: faster product versus more stable product, why reversibility decides the winner, and 1,2 vs 1,4 addition.
lewis-structures: Lewis structure notes: drawing molecules with the valence rule, reading condensed formulas, assigning formal charge, and real exceptions to the octet rule.
newman: Newman projection notes: drawing conformations, staggered vs eclipsed energy, torsional and steric strain, and butane's anti and gauche conformers.
polymer-basics: Polymer basics: how monomer functionality predicts chains or networks, addition vs condensation polymers, chain-growth vs step-growth, nylons and polyesters.
radical-halogenation: Radical halogenation notes: homolysis and fishhook arrows, initiation, propagation and termination, why bromination is selective, and allylic bromination.
skeletal-structures: Skeletal structure notes: the rules for reading line-angle drawings, implied hydrogens and charges, converting to condensed formulas, and drawing rings.
sn2: SN2 mechanism notes: the concerted step, backside attack and inversion of configuration, steric hindrance, second-order rate law, solvent and nucleophile.
uv-vis: UV-Vis spectroscopy notes: pi to pi-star transitions, why more conjugation means longer wavelength and color, the Beer-Lambert law, and substituent shifts.
